subject.title: test: table-drive followup scenarios, centralize sanitizer wiring, remove obsolete negatives

question: Should this protected test-cleanup PR be accepted after a rebase and confirmation that the shared contract is the canonical owner for all affected channel sanitizer wiring?
rationale: The `maintainer` label requires explicit human handling, and accepting broad deletion of focused regression tests depends on maintainers agreeing that the shared test is the durable ownership boundary.

options.title: Rebase and land the consolidation
options.body: Confirm the eight plugin IDs are the complete shared-sanitizer set, rerun the affected suites on the rebased head, and merge if no contract gap appears.

options.title: Retain selected local regressions
options.body: Keep any channel-specific test whose behavior is not independently covered by the common sanitizer suite, then land the narrower consolidation.

options.title: Pause the cleanup
options.body: Close or defer the test reduction if maintainers do not want a shared plugin-shape contract to own this channel coverage.

recommendation.title: Rebase and land the consolidation
recommendation.body: Confirm the eight plugin IDs are the complete shared-sanitizer set, rerun the affected suites on the rebased head, and merge if no contract gap appears.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored the cleanup series and is the only concrete routing candidate present in the supplied commit and timeline evidence.
